prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 3 tests.
'sign_in, redesign' changes have consistently shown negative results after noise correction across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for 'adoption, redesign', 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as tests either lack a second trial or disagree on effect.
Predictions have mostly been overestimated compared to noise-corrected measurements, though rounds 7, 8, 9, 12, 13, and 14 were underestimated.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -0.7% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -0.1% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: +0.0% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +0.6% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -3.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -7.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.2%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, hint] pick_friend_trait_filter_hint: Show a clear hint on the pick_friend screen assuring users that pet traits and appearance can be changed at any time after setup. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (68.4%) and high median completion time (89s), indicating user hesitation during pet selection.)
1: [finish, new_screen] new_pet_visibility_helper_screen: Add a new screen after home intro guiding users on how to locate the pet icon in the system tray or taskbar if the pet window does not open automatically. (why: Support emails report cases where the pet does not show up on desktop or app will not open ([home_first_view, bug]).)
2: [home, wait_info] waiting_stage_progress_info: Display time estimates and step counts on the waiting screen during pet generation. (why: The home stage has a high median time (201s) and mean time (2336s) where users lack progress feedback while waiting.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] story_full_bleed_redesign: Redesign the initial story screen into a full-bleed visual showcase introducing the desktop pet concept. (why: The choose_path stage suffers from a long mean duration (514s), requiring stronger early engagement.)
4: [adoption, layout] upload_photos_quality_checklist: Add a photo requirement checklist to the photo upload screen to ensure high-quality source photos. (why: Support received reports that custom pets fail to generate or look wrong due to bad input images ([adoption_or_generation, bug]).)
5: [sign_in, reorder] sign_in_after_adoption_certificate_reorder: Move sign-in to take place immediately after finalizing the pet adoption certificate. (why: 8 support emails report missing or reset pets after signing in, which occurs when users sign in before establishing their pet choice.)
6: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_existing_account_hint: Add explanatory hint text on sign_in emphasizing that returning users should sign in with their existing account to sync saved pets. (why: 8 support tickets mention pets missing or being reset after signing into a new or incorrect account.)
7: [finish, new_flow] new_pet_desktop_controls_flow: Insert an interactive tutorial screen after home intro showing basic desktop controls for dragging, right-clicking, and hiding the pet. (why: Support received multiple messages regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the desktop pet ([after_onboarding, confusion]).)
8: [adoption, layout] adoption_certificate_compact_layout: Switch the adoption certificate screen to a compact layout to decrease visual clutter during naming. (why: Adoption stage has the lowest step conversion rate (68.4%), so simplifying certificate finalization helps user momentum.)
9: [finish, notification] home_intro_notify_when_ready: Enable desktop notification options on home intro screen when pet initialization completes. (why: Finish step has a very high mean time (5815s) because users switch away while waiting for pet loading.)

scores.note: Adoption stage loses the most users (68.4% conversion); adding a clear hint is low-risk and config-only.
Support and funnel point to this issue, but historical tests show finish new_screen changes yield +0.0% lift.
Home step has long wait times (201s median); progress feedback reduces drop-off during generation.
Full redesigns historically underperform or show negative results, alongside high implementation cost.
Targeting lowest conversion step with strong support mail evidence; checklist prevents user input errors.
Supported by 8 emails, but previous sign_in reorder test resulted in -7.2% conversion.
Fixes account reset confusion reported in 8 support emails using a simple, low-risk hint.
New flow additions consistently show no clear positive effect across past tests and require full release.
Modest layout simplification on the lowest conversion step, but lacking specific support mail backing.
Directly targets extreme mean time (5815s) caused by background waiting with ready notifications.
